hooks.command: sh -c 'root=${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}; [ -n "$root" ] || { echo "Lemmings plugin root is unavailable" >&2; exit 1; }; exec sh "$root/hooks/run.sh"'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$pluginRoot = if ($env:CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not $pluginRoot) { throw 'Lemmings plugin root is unavailable' }; & (Join-Path $pluginRoot 'hooks/run.ps1'); exit $LASTEXITCODE"
